  "passage_answerability": true,
  "meaningfully_distinct": true,
  "evidence_ids": [
    "E1.1",
    "E1.2"
  ],
  "reasons": [
    "A matches NCERT’s survival criterion: an organisation must earn enough revenues to cover costs (E1.1).",
    "B reverses NCERT’s account of growth, which requires adding to long-run prospects (E1.2).",
    "C contradicts NCERT’s statement that mere survival is not enough and profit must be ensured (E1.1).",
    "D mislabels the trio: NCERT identifies survival, profit and growth as economic objectives (E1.1)."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Nature & Significance of Management",
  "syllabus_topic": "Management objectives: survival, profit and growth",
  "syllabus_entitlement": true,
  "presentation_ready": true,
  "question_type_match": true,
  "principle_applicability": "excerpt_required",
  "decisive_principle_in_excerpts": true,
  "answer_conditions": [
    {
      "condition": "Apply NCERT’s identification of survival, profit and growth as the economic objectives of a business.",
      "status": "convention",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": [
        "E1.1"
      ]
    },
    {
      "condition": "Apply NCERT’s survival criterion that revenues must be sufficient to cover costs.",
      "status": "convention",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": [
        "E1.1"
      ]
    },
    {
      "condition": "Apply NCERT’s description of growth as adding to long-run prospects.",
      "status": "convention",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": [
        "E1.2"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "B",
      "strongest_reading": "Read “avoid adding” as cautious restraint on expansion, but NCERT says growth requires adding to long-run prospects.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "strongest_reading": "Read profit as dispensable once survival is secure, but NCERT says mere survival is insufficient and profit must be ensured.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "Read “social” loosely as beneficial to society; NCERT places survival, profit and growth under economic objectives.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "blocking_defects": [],
  "style_notes": [
    "The reversed wording in B and C makes those distractors easy to reject once the NCERT definitions are recalled."
  ],
  "cuet_fit": {
    "criteria": {
      "syllabus_objective": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Tests the unit’s central management objective of explaining survival, profit and growth."
      },
      "format_authenticity": {
        "level": 2,
        "evidence": "A valid four-option objective MCQ; no matched authenticated comparator was supplied."
      },
      "level_calibration": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Direct recall of a central Class XII NCERT concept; no matched authenticated comparator was supplied."
      },
      "discrimination_value": {
        "level": 2,
        "evidence": "Choosing A requires knowing the survival criterion, though B and C are readily eliminated."
      }
    },
    "reasoning_steps": 1,
    "estimated_difficulty": "easy",
    "cognitive_level": "recall",
    "exemplar_ids_compared": []
  },
  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "In order to survive, an organisation must earn enough revenues to cover costs.",
      "reason": "This directly states the option’s survival criterion."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "avoid adding to its prospects in the long run",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.2",
      "premise_quote": "A business needs to add to its prospects in the long run",
      "reason": "NCERT says growth requires adding to long-run prospects, not avoiding it."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "making a profit is no longer necessary",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "Mere survival is not enough for business. Management has to ensure that the organisation makes a profit.",
      "reason": "NCERT says profit must be ensured; survival alone is not enough."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "the three social objectives",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "fulfill the economic objectives of a business. These are survival, profit and growth.",
      "reason": "NCERT identifies this trio as the business’s economic objectives."
    }
  ]
}
